card.name: Blood transfusion wording
card.fires_on: Words about blood transfusion, especially 'products' after 'blood', and the pieces of 'transfusion' or 'transfuse'. Also a few other partway pieces of blood-related medical words.

modes.label: Transfusion words
modes.description: The word transfusion or transfuse, or the piece 'transf' after 'blood'.
modes.example: Administer blood<< transf>>usions per clinical guidelines.

modes.label: Blood products
modes.description: The word 'products' right after 'blood' when talking about transfusing it.

modes.description: Partway through other hematology words such as thrombocytopenia or allogeneic.
